name: claudetto
description: Lists the claudetto plugin and its optional browser and docs plugins.

plugins.name: claudetto
plugins.description: Adds a lean output style, a main agent with a roster of six agents, and a permission gate that answers each permission prompt. Adds a status line command with the plan usage, and the `setup` skill. Adds the MiniSpec skills `propose`, `apply`, `verify`, `archive`, `explore`, `update`, and `sync`. Adds a handover to a fresh session in place of the compaction summary, and a `goal` check. Adds a check of each ticked task, a ledger of edited files, and a cleanup at session start. With a key, Jev answers `AskUserQuestion`, the asks of the gate, and the handover offer. A Haiku 5.5 classifier settles each ask of the gate that Jev does not settle.

plugins.name: claudetto-browser
plugins.description: Drives a real browser with `agent-browser` for pages that need JavaScript, a login, or clicks, and for checks of a UI change. `WebFetch` and `WebSearch` stay the tools for reading and search, because they cost fewer tokens.
